title: MFA Login Rate-Limited Response
description: HTTP 429 body for POST /api/v1/auth/login (second leg, `mfa_token` supplied) when the per-user MFA login attempt budget (5 attempts per 300 seconds, counted across IPs and workers) is exhausted. Same envelope shape as rate_limit_info_schema.json but with its own error_code, so clients can branch on it; distinct from a wrong code (HTTP 401). The `Retry-After` response header carries the seconds until the window resets. If the limiter store is unavailable the server fails closed and keeps answering the generic 401 invalid-MFA response; it does NOT emit this body.

retry_after.description: Seconds until the window resets (mirrors the Retry-After header).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the MFA login attempt window resets.
